messages:
Nina (partnerships): Quick kickoff — we need to get Redwood CloudStore 2.0 listed across AWS/GCP/Azure. Focus for day0: publisher creds, AMIs/images, SKU + trial packaging, KMS/keys, and legal EULA. Can folks confirm owners?
Marco (product): I can own SKU + trial packaging. rough Qs: trial duration, seat model vs metered tokens?
Elaine (legal): Need final EULA + data processing paragraph. ETA for a draft from us is EOD Tue unless there are special compliance asks. Any EU-specific clauses?
Sam (cloud-ops): I'll own publisher account setup and IAM role wiring. Need publisher account IDs and target regions. Ping me the AWS account and GCP project IDs.
Jonah (engineering): I'll handle AMI bake + regional replication for AWS, image snapshots for GCP, and VM image packaging for Azure. Will need build infra access and a minimal tf snippet for roles.
Nina (partnerships): Owners confirmed: Marco=packaging, Sam=account+iam, Jonah=image builds, Elaine=legal. I'll coordinate marketplace ops and timeline. Goal: staging listing by next Friday.
Marco (product): Proposal for trial: 14-day trial with 5000 token monthly allocation, and option to convert to pay-as-you-go. Pricing tiers: dev (1k req/mo), pro (10k), scale (50k) — will draft pricing matrix.
Elaine (legal): 14-day trial ok. We'll need language for trial cancellation, billing transition, and telemetry retention (30 days default, 90 days on request). Also checks for regional data residency — flag if customer requests EU-only processing.
Sam (cloud-ops): Publisher IDs: AWS 987654321098, GCP delta-project-ops. Jonah, deploying cross-region will require this IAM role snippet: `
resource "aws_iam_role" "marketplace_publisher" {
  name = "redwood-marketplace-publisher"
  assume_role_policy = <<POLICY
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::987654321098:root"},
    "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
  }]
}
POLICY
}
`
Sam (cloud-ops): I'll drop the full tf in the repo. Also: need KMS key ARN and rotation policy — does legal require CMK with rotation?
Elaine (legal): We prefer CMK with rotation enabled. Also ask security to confirm key management SLA.
Nina (partnerships): Assets needed from marketing: hero logo (svg/png), 1-paragraph product blurb, 3 screenshots, and a short getting-started guide. Can marketing get these by Wed? @Marco can you coordinate? :eyes:
Marco (product): Yep, I'll coordinate with marketing. I'll also prepare a small sample usage snippet for the listing and a quickstart that uses hosted API keys.
Jonah (engineering): CI note — AMI pipeline will publish AMI IDs to `marketplace-images` SSM param / repo after bake. We'll need a test plan: smoke start, cert checks, region replication test.
Nina (partnerships): Marketplace-bot, create tasks for the owners and set reminders for mid-week check.
marketplace-bot: Tasks created: T-501 (publisher creds) assigned to Sam, due 1797400000; T-502 (trial + pricing) assigned to Marco, due 1797420000; T-503 (EULA draft) assigned to Elaine, due 1797423600; T-504 (AMI bake + replication) assigned to Jonah, due 1797440000.
Sam (cloud-ops): I'll request the publisher console invites now. Also question — do we want trial entitlements implemented as coupon codes or automatic 14-day entitlement?
Marco (product): Prefer automatic entitlement tied to signup to reduce friction; coupon codes for partner promos.
Elaine (legal): Auto-entitlement fine, just capture consent and TOS acceptance at signup.
Nina (partnerships): OK action items: 1) Sam: collect account IDs & publish tf snippet (today) 2) Jonah: start AMI pipeline (tomorrow) 3) Marco: draft pricing + assets request to marketing (tomorrow) 4) Elaine: EULA draft (EOD Tue). Mid-week sync Thu 10:30 PT.
Jonah (engineering): Noted. Will post bake logs to #eng-runtime and link here.
Marco (product): I'll share the sample pricing table and a 1-page product blurb by EOD tomorrow.
Nina (partnerships): Thanks all — will follow up with calendar invite for Thu 10:30 PT and a short checklist doc in the partnership repo. :thumbsup:
Elaine (legal): :thumbsup:
Sam (cloud-ops): Adding helm for Azure images to the repo now.
marketplace-bot: Reminder scheduled for 1797490000 (mid-week check).
Nina (partnerships): If anything blocks earlier, ping me directly. Otherwise see you Thu.
